name: Doan Karhan
summary: In the southern Barrens, Doan Karhan pursues dangerous studies far from Alliance lands. The human scholar lives alone, studying the Burning Legion’s demonic artifacts and seeking knowledge of the Orb of Soran'ruk.

sections.title: The Hermit of the Barrens
sections.body: Doan Karhan keeps a solitary camp in the southern Barrens, far from the Alliance’s settled lands. He withdrew into the wilderness so he could study dangerous demonic relics without disturbance. He knows much about powerful fel vessels and possesses the Orb of Zargain. Yet his thoughts are fixed on the legendary Orb of Soran'ruk. Warlocks come to him for knowledge of artifact crafting and dark rituals.

faq.answer: Doan Karhan camps in the southern Barrens, east of Camp Taurajo and the main road. His small clearing is easy to overlook, and he lives there alone.

faq.q: Why is a human living alone in the Barrens?
aliases: why is there a human in barrens
faq.answer: Doan Karhan chose exile in the hostile wilderness to study the Burning Legion’s magical relics. Alliance lands forbid or closely scrutinize such studies of demonic orbs.

faq.q: What is the Orb of Soran'ruk?
faq.answer: The Orb of Soran'ruk is an ancient Legion relic, potent and filled with dark power. Doan Karhan knows much about its construction and the similar Orb of Zargain. He guides warlocks who seek to reconstruct it.

angles.text: As a seasoned warlock, you can seek Doan Karhan’s arcane knowledge to uncover, mend, and wield legendary demonic orbs.
Though Doan Karhan is human, he lives far from Stormwind and Theramore. He chose lonely exile in Kalimdor’s heartland over the constraints of the Grand Alliance.
